description: SWCalibrateR is an R Shiny application for calibrating soil moisture sensors against field measurements. Johannes Brenner and collaborators provide an interactive workflow for filtering paired observations, fitting ordinary least-squares or robust linear relationships, plotting the results and examining influential observations. The paper identifies gravimetric samples as calibration references and describes filtering by soil or land-use categories. Spatial coverage and observation periods depend on the uploaded measurements; no uniform sensor network is distributed. The software can prepare moisture observations for irrigation and hydrological simulations. Code is free under MIT, with local installation instructions and a link to an online example. It complements related process models by addressing calibration of their observation inputs. A limitation is the linear calibration formulation and the need for representative reference samples; removing outliers can change the fitted relationship. The hosted example was not tested and no field measurements were uploaded or downloaded.
name: SWCalibrateR soil moisture sensor calibration
